text:
matt: Heads-up — post-merge rollout for payments-chart v2.4.0 -> v2.5.0 starts in ~30m. Staggered regions: us-east1 -> europe-west1 -> ap-south1. We've bumped redis.maxconn in values and toggled a new feature flag. Plan: migrate=false for first two regions, run migration only in final region if everything is green. Pin/revert policy: prefer pin to avoid schema mismatch if anything odd. Any blockers?
lara: Quick q — are migrations helm hooks or a separate job? want to confirm no automatic DB upgrade on canary.
matt: migrations are a Job included in the chart behind migrate=true. we'll keep migrate=false for the early regions as discussed.
ashley: +1 on keep-migrate-off. also suggest increase readiness probe timeout for payments-web; we saw flakiness last deploy.
deploy-bot: deploy started: helm upgrade --install payments payments-chart --namespace prod --version 2.5.0 -f values-us-east.yaml --set image.tag=2026-03-18
status: initiated
jorge: tailing logs: new pod payments-web-5b7b... serving 503s intermittently, looks like backend pool flapping.
sre-oncall: bumping HPA minReplicas to 3 for canary to soak traffic temporarily, applying patch now.
matt: Decision criteria: if errors > 5% sustained for 5m in canary -> block further rollouts and pin chart back to 2.4.0. Otherwise continue. Release notes: explicitly call out migrate=false by default.
lara: I'll update release notes and changelog snippet with the migration flag and probe change.
ashley: can we also annotate helm release with rollback-reason when we pin? helps audit.
deploy-bot: canary health check: 5m error rate = 5.8% -> marking CANARY_UNHEALTHY. Initiating pin vs rollback checklist.
matt: We should prefer pin (chart pin) instead of hard rollback to avoid DB mismatch window. Pin flow: block rollout, create PR to pin Chart.yaml and update release notes, scale back new replicas.
deploy-bot: proposed action: block further regions, create PR to pin chart to 2.4.0 and append release notes. Confirm to proceed? [y/N]
matt: y. proceed with pin and create PR. Also flip traffic-split back to old pool for immediate mitigation.
deploy-bot: action taken: blocked region rollouts. Created PR #4789 to pin chart repo and add rollback commentary. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/helm-charts/pulls/4789
lara: release notes updated: "Staggered rollout paused after us-east1 canary due to elevated error rate (5.8%). Migration flag remains OFF. Chart pinned to v2.4.0 for stability. Follow-up: increase readiness probe timeout and investigate affinity rules."
ashley: after pin, I'll trigger a controlled rolling restart of the older RS to get healthy pods back in service.
release-captain: Added a short note to the deployment ticket and flagged for postmortem.
sre-oncall: Creating incident INC-2026-042 and spinning up #inc-inc-2026-042 channel. Notifying eng-sre, eng-releases, product.
matt: TL;DR: paused rollout after us-east canary hit >5% errors. We pinned back to v2.4.0, PR created to record pin and rationale, hold on other regions. Next steps: merge pin PR, revert traffic-split when old pods healthy, run deeper probe/affinity analysis, and schedule follow-up patch release. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
